distribution: Xinglong, Hainan; Simao, Mangshi and Santaishi, Yunnan; abroad it is found in Java and Sumatra, Indonesia.
worker: Head oval, widest slightly behind the antennal sockets. The middle of the vertex is rather high, with a small shallow depression in front of it and another behind it. The postclypeus is markedly raised, less than half as long as wide. Antennae with 14 segments, segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4. The anterior part of the pronotum is semicircular and very highly raised. The abdomen is long and swollen, the legs short.
